description:
Beyond Earth, Beyond Limits! 

We are ZENITHX, a team of curious minds, creative thinkers, and aspiring innovators passionate about space and technology. Through the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge, we aim to turn space exploration into an exciting, interactive adventure for young explorers. Combining coding, creativity, AI, and teamwork, we dream of building something impactful, engaging, and out of this world. Let's dream big, innovate boldly, and explore the universe together!
